delivery_policy: Exact CI-built bytes; the same wheel passed all sixteen installed-artifact jobs. No rebuild substituted for that wheel.
additional_local_validation: Six local stable-wheel environments passed 695 executed tests with 19 expected skips. The exact CI wheel was separately installed and smoke-tested locally.
quality_gates: strict Twine metadata validation for delivered wheel and sdist
source distribution matches 82 current repository files
private work and audit-only records excluded from distributions
documented_limits: Hard-link support required for no-overwrite atomic publication
Native decoding cancellation/resource accounting are not hard OS isolation
Encrypted, split/multivolume and self-extracting archives unsupported
Unusual color/high-bit-depth combinations and extreme PDF sizes need broader corpus validation
Default JPEG inspection validates headers; --decode-verify adds pixel decoding
remaining_publication_steps: Explicit approval before merge, remote tag, package-index upload or GitHub release
Select the exact reviewed CI-built artifacts and tested commit when publishing
